training_existing.T4-T7: WL68 held-out slots 4-7 (ports 2148, 1025, 2707, 2422); now development data

training_new_slots.note: inside the pt0 dent (14.8 mm from its centre)
inside the pt0 dent (15.8 mm from its centre)

ports.ordering: WL66/WL68 rule: ports on the slot face sorted by (round(rest-xy distance to target, 1e-9 m), port index); first admissible port is taken; no reselection
ports.admissibility_final: min over bins of (1-beta) >= 0.5 at rest AND cf2; >= 0.01 m from every slab side; >= 0.01 m (rest xy, same face) from every port that has any WL66/WL68 probe reference (WL66 slots 0-3, WL68 slots 4-7) and every previously chosen final port; never equal to such a port
ports.admissibility_training_new: min over bins of (1-beta) >= 0.5 at rest AND pt0; >= 0.01 m from every slab side; >= 0.01 m (rest xy, same face) from every final port, every existing training port and every previously chosen new training port
ports.order_of_selection: final ports first (slots 20-27), then new training ports (8-15)
ports.information_used: geometry only (rest material coordinates, face index, beta); no probe response, model output or error

references.estimator: unchanged WL66/WL68 estimator (WL57 first-exit importance action, one-hot proposal, fast walker, WL63 observational tags), via fnto_repr68.probes68 gates
references.seed_formula: 713000000 + geometry_index*1000000 + slot*10000 + bin*100 + replica; geometry_index rest 0, pt0 1, cf2 2; non-evidence smoke 719000000+
references.chunk: execution configuration chosen before generation by the preflight rule (preflight71.json): 32M action chunk with per-packet fallback to 16M after a CUDA OOM (the packet is retried from its own seed; the chunk is recorded in its receipt) if the measured 32M rate exceeds the 16M rate, else 16M. The chunk only partitions photons into independent batches of the same estimator.
references.gates: every packet passes the WL68 physical/tag/one-hot/unit-input/finite gates; any failure stops generation (failed packet preserved)

precision.rule: per-matrix coarse collided signal/SE (unbiased cross-replica signal, jackknife SE) per channel; abs metrics pool matrices meeting the abs rule in all channels; deformation metrics pool Delta matrices meeting the deformation rule in all channels. If fewer than 4 of 8 final matrices (per group) qualify, that gate is UNMEASURED.

populations.fit_population_scoring: replicas 4-7 of the population's own slots (never seen by a fit)

final_groups.DEF_cf2: Delta_k = R(cf2)_k - R(rest)_k at slots 20-27 (independent packets), prediction model(cf2) - model(rest)

populations.R64: teacher-only broad set: 64 ports drawn with numpy default_rng(71064) from all ports not in S16 and not final, evaluated noise-free at rest and cf2

budget_accounting.S4_fixed_precision: 4 sources x 4 replicas x 32M photons per (geometry, bin) = 512M photons per bin-geometry
budget_accounting.S16_fixed_precision: 16 sources x 4 replicas = 2048M (4x the supervision photons of S4)
budget_accounting.S16_fixed_budget: 16 sources x replica 0 only = 512M (equal to S4)

J_5901.arm: separately controlled joint A/O, expanded (compare with WL68 net_all_5901, sparse joint)

J_5902.arm: separately controlled joint A/O, expanded (compare with WL68 net_all_5902)

init_rule: every run starts from the named WL59 checkpoint with in_logits/out_logits replaced by the fixed WL68 net_all_5902 angular bases (spatial and joint arms alike)

teachers.TA: WL68 run net_all_5902, complete (a physically fitted admissible member)
teachers.TB: P_5902 network with the fixed WL68 net_all_5902 angular bases (WL59's own smooth spatial map)
teachers.targets: noise-free collided native responses of the teacher at the student's training sources (rest, pt0); the student never sees teacher responses elsewhere

optimizer: WL68 'net' optimizer for every run: Adam (0.9/0.999, 1e-8), full batch, float32, TF32 off, lr 3e-3 -> 3e-5 cosine over 20,000 steps, clip 1.0, log every 25; WL68 objective J (family68.objective) averaged over the training geometries; final iterate kept; converged iff WL68 last-decile rule (< 1 %)

oracle.label: LABELLED ORACLE (uses final references): admissible spatial T >= 0, sum <= 1, for the fixed WL68 A/O, fitted on final replica 0 and scored on replicas 1-3 (eval68.transfer_oracle split for K < 6), FISTA 1500 iterations; never a candidate

quality.apply: WL59/WL68 original thresholds; upper 95 % jackknife bound, all three channels, pooled per group (fit population per training geometry)

deformation.apply: WL59 dynamic thresholds on DEF_cf2 qualified matrices: upper 95 % relative error of the signed coarse change and corr of mean signed coarse change, every channel

decision.primary: the D1 run (D1_5901, D1_5902) with the lower final training J
decision.S_fit: primary passes quality on S16 (rest and pt0, eval replicas 4-7)
decision.S_def: primary passes the deformation criteria on DEF_cf2
decision.improves: for FIN_rest AND FIN_cf2, the primary's worst-channel upper bounds of con_coarse and abs_coarse are each <= 0.8 x those of the C run with the same init
decision.adequate: primary converged AND both expanded teacher students (TA_S16, TB_S16) pass the teacher criteria at their training sources AND the final groups are precision-qualified
decision.teacher_generalizes: TA_S16 and TB_S16 each pass the teacher criteria on FIN ports (rest, cf2), on R64 (rest, cf2) and the teacher deformation criteria
decision.outcome: A if S_fit and S_cross and S_state and S_def; else B if improves; else C if adequate (labelled C/teacher-generalizes or C/teacher-fails); else D
decision.family_statement: A: generalizes on the tested coverage; B: coverage helps but gates remain; C: adequately controlled supervision fails (C/teacher-generalizes: the procedure generalizes a same-family rule from this coverage, so the physical failure points at the map's reachable rule set; C/teacher-fails: the procedure/map cannot recover even a same-family rule from this coverage); D: confounded
decision.descriptive_only: D2 vs D1 (precision at fixed budget), J vs WL68 sparse joint, oracle, extended fields, Stage 1, development groups

extended_fields: eval68.extended (WL59 original metrics on the historical rest/pt0/cf3 fields) and eval68.passivity for every network candidate; regression = coarse mean above the frozen checkpoint of the same seed (descriptive)
prohibited: selecting ports or populations by model output
reading final references or eval replicas during fitting

execution.lanes_rule: dev-measured peaks: S4 1.06 GB, S16 3.35 GB, joint 3.72 GB per fit on the 12 GB GPU; two concurrent fits (worst 7.4 GB) leave margin, three would not. Per-run seconds are therefore contended timings (labelled in each run).

execution.reference_preflight: dev-measured 32M chunk 3.40 s/packet (peak 9.53 GB) vs 16M 5.16 s; evidence preflight repeats the measurement by rule

amendments.stage: reference generation, after 175 of 3072 packets (all gates passed), before any fit or analysis
amendments.reason: the 32M->16M OOM fallback retried inside the except handler, where the traceback still held the failed attempt's tensors; one fallback succeeded (rest slot 9 bin 5 rep 6), the next 32M OOM (rest slot 9 bin 5 rep 7) failed again at 16M and stopped generation
amendments.change: execution only: the retry runs after the handler exits, with gc.collect() and empty_cache() (probes71.trace). Estimator, seeds, chunk rule, packets and every rule unchanged; completed packets and receipts kept; the failed packet is regenerated from its own seed.
